t: Beezeh keli notelin layyadayim, veketzad yabou hammayim leyadayv
s: Beezeh keli notelin layyadayim, veketzad yabou hammayim leyadayv, ubo k"h seipim: en notelin layyadayim ella mikkeli, shessameku tohorat yadayim al hazzaat me chattat o al qiddush yadayim veraglayim bammiqdash shehayu tzerikim keli, shebbeqiddush yadayim veraglayim neemar: "veasita kiyyor vego' verachatzu mimmennu vego'", ubeme chattat neemar: "venatan alayv mayim chayyim el keli":
Kol hakkelim kesherim, apillu kele gelalim, kele abanim, kele adama, sheenam chashubim kelim leinyan tuma:
Tzarik sheyyehe hakkeli machaziq rebiit, veim eno machaziq rebiit — en notelin mimmennu layyadayim, apillu rotzeh lemallovato b' veg' peamim:

Veim niqqab bekones mashqeh, dehaynu sheim yidchaqu oto letok mayim yikkanesu hammayim betoko derek hanneqeb, vehu gadol minneqeb shehammashqin shebbetok hakkeli yotzeim bo — az batel mittorat keli. Veen notelin mimmennu layyadayim, apillu im hu machaziq rebiit min hanneqeb ulematta, im notel derek piv lemala, ki mah shemmimmennu min hanneqeb umillemala — eno chashub keli, venimtza sheen hammayim baim al yado mehakkeli. (Vaapillu en bo mayim ella mehanneqeb ulematta, mikkol maqom, kesheshshopekam al yadayv derek piv — hem baim al yadayv mikkoach dabar sheeno keli, shemmikkoach hakkeli lo hayu baim sham al yadayv, shehen semukot lepi hakkeli, dehaynu sheim mah shehu lemala mehanneqeb lo haya kelal vehayu hammayim shopekim millematta mimmaqom shehanneqeb sham — lo hayu shopekin al yadayv kelal im haya ochez yadayv bemaqom sheochazan akshav samuk lepi hakkeli kesheshshopek lemala derek pi hakkeli. Ella im ken magbiah shule hakkeli gaboah yoter mippiv, sheaz vadday ap im mah shellemala mehanneqeb lo haya kelal — hayu hammayim holekim mimmala lematta al yadayv derek hanneqeb kemo sheholekim akshav derek pi hakkeli. Vehu haddin ap im eno magbiah kol kak, ella shehanneqeb hu samuk lepi hakkeli umagbiha shulayv qetzat beinyan shehaqqilluach haya holek al yadayv ap im lo hayeta chatikat hakkeli shellemala mehanneqeb shehaqqilluach holek aleha, raq shehayu chatikot hakkeli shebbitzdade haqqilluach shellemala mehanneqeb, shetztzedadim ellu moneim et hammayim millehitpashshet latztzedadin. Veap shemmeniatan zo hi mikkoach dabar sheeno keli — en bekak kelum, kemo sheyyitbaer). Veim notel derek hanneqeb — muttar bekol inyan, kevan shemmachaziq rebiit mimmennu ulematta. Veen tzarik lomar im shabar vehesir mah shellemala mehanneqeb:

Abal im eno machaziq rebiit mehanneqeb ulematta, ap al pi sheyyakol leqabbel rebiit kesheyyattennu al tziddo, kegon shettiqqen vehirchib meqom moshabo shello yishshapeku mimmennu mayim kesheyyattehu al tziddo. Veken chabit shennechleqa leorkah shehi meqabbelet al dopnah keshehi shokebet beli sheyyismekuha bedabar acher — en notelin mimmenna layyadayim, lepi shekkol keli sheeno yakol leqabbel keshehu yosheb al shulayv ella keshemmattehu al dopno — eno niqra keli ella sheber keli, hoil veen mishtammeshin bo keshehu yosheb al shulayv. Veyesh meqillin bekol sheber keli sheyyakol leqabbel rebiit beli sheyyismekuhu bedabar acher. Veyesh lismok al dibrehem, lehaqel bedibre soperim. Abal im eno yakol leqabbel rebiit ella al yede semika — ledibre hakkol en notelin mimmennu apillu hu shalem, im mittechillato naasa leqabbel shello al yede semika veachar kak nipchat qetzat bimqom moshabo sheen bo neqeb:

Lepikak, megupa shel chabit sheyyesh bah bet qibbul rebiit — en notelin mimmenna, mippene shehi chadda veenah meqabbelet rebiit shello mesummeket. Veim hirchibah millematta ad shehi meqabbelet rebiit keshehi yoshebet shello mesummeket — notelin mimmenna, veap al pi shemmittechillatah lo naaset leqabbala ella lekissuy, hoil veakshav hi metuqqenet gam leqabbala. Abal kol kissuy shello tiqqeno leqabbala, ap al pi sheyyakol leqabbel keshehu yosheb shello mesummak, kegon kissuy kosot vedomehen — en notelin mehen. Veyesh meqillin bekol kissuye hakkelim lomar shehem chashubim asuyim leqabbala, hoil uregilim lipamim litten letokam meat mashqeh. Vaapillu kissuy sheenah yekola lesheb shello mesummak mippene hachiddud shebbetachtito, kegon kissuy qedera vekayyotze bah, regilim lipamim (lehazmino) lehapeko al pi haqqedera velatet letoko meat roteb, ulepikak notelin mimmennu layyadayim im yakol lesheb shello mesummak, ap al pi shello tiqqeno leqabbala, kegon shennishbar hachiddud meelayv. Veyesh lehachamir kassebara harishona:

Keli sheeno yakol lesheb shello mesummak, ella sheap im lo yismekuhu veyishshapeku hammayim mimmennu yishshaer mehem rebiit — notelin mimmennu layyadayim meotam hammayim shemmachaziq ap keshemmutteh al tziddo, abal lo mimmayim yeterim shemmachaziq kesheochazin oto bayyadayim bemishor, shehem enam baim mikkoach keli. Veken keli shenniqqab venotelin mimmennu derek hanneqeb — en notelin ella mimmayim shemmachaziq ad hanneqeb, abal lo mimmayim shemminneqeb ulemala, shehem enan baim mikkoach keli ap al pi shebbaim derek hanneqeb:

Chemet ukepisha, vehem mine nodot shel or shettiqqenan veasa lahem bet moshab — notelin mehem, vaapillu nipchatu mippihem o mitztziddehem, kol shemmachaziqin rebiit mehappechat ulematta. Abal hassaq vehaqquppa shehitqinan lashebet belo semika vezippetan bezepet ad shehem meqabbelim mashqin — en notelin mehem layyadayim, lepi sherubban en melaktan lemashqin. Vehu haddin lekobaim shel lebadim, apillu hem qashim kol kak sheen mayim zabim mehem, mikkol maqom enan asuyim leqabbel mayim. Umikkol maqom, al yede haddechaq muttar littol mehem, lepi sheobere derakim regilim lishtot bahem, ulekak enan domin legamre lesaq ulequppa, sheen regilut kelal lehishtammesh bahem lemashqin, vehammishtammesh botla dato etzel kol adam. Veyesh oserim apillu bishat haddechaq, hoil velo naasa leqabbala kelal mittechillatan, vegam atta enan omedin lekak. Veenan domin lekissuy hakkelim sheyyekolim lesheb shello mesummakim sheyyesh mattirin littol mehem, lepi shergilim lipamim litten bahem meat mashqin, abal bekobaim en regilut kelal ella beobere derakim bilbad, ubotla datam etzel kol adam (vegam hem enan mazminin otam lekak, ella shotin bahem beaqray al yede haddechaq). (Ulehaoserin bekissuy kelim ap al pi sheyyekolim lesheb shello mesummakim kol shello tiqqenam leqabbala — asur littol mikkobaim apillu bishat haddechaq ap lepi sebara rishona (ukebar nitbaer sheyyesh lachosh ledibrehem)):

Keli shemmittechillato tiqqenuhu kak sheeno yakol laamod belo semika, veen mishtammeshin bo ella al yede semika — eno batel mittorat keli mippene zeh, kevan shellekak naasa mittechillato, vezeh iqqar tashmisho:

Lepikak, keli shehu male neqabim mittachtayv upiv tzar millemala ukeshemmanniach adam etzbao alayv en hammayim yotzeim ukeshemmesirah hammayim yotzeim — muttar littol mimmennu ap al pi sheeno machaziq kelum, shekkevan sheasuy leqabbala beinyan zeh vezeh iqqar tashmisho — niqra keli. Abal kol dabar shello naasa leqabbala — en moil lo mah shellekak naasa mittechillato vezeh iqqar tashmisho, kegon qanqannim sheenam shavim lemala ella bolet mehem, kemo dad sheshshopekim derek sham vehu gaboah yoter mehakkeli (o shessipte hakkeli atzman enam shavin, ella gebohim mitztzad echad unemukim mitztzad echad, o sheyyesh bahem chiddudim yotzeim veyesh ben chiddud lachabero kekones mashqeh — en notelin bammaqom haggaboah ella bammaqom hannamuk). Veen tzarik lomar beqanqannim sheyyesh bahem neqeb betziddehem samuk lepihem, sheen notelin mehem ella derek hanneqeb, shemmehanneqeb ulemala en alehem torat keli ap al pi shekkak naasu mittechillatam, hoil veenam asuyim leqabbala mehanneqeb ulemala. Abal keli sheyyesh bo barza lematta — muttar littol yadayv mimmennu al yede hasarat habbarza ap al pi shehammayim baim millemala mehanneqeb, hoil venaasa mittechillato leqabbel al yede barza, vezeh iqqar tashmisho. Apillu haya keli shalem legamre mittechillato veachar kak niqqebo veasa lo barza — hare zeh kitchillat tiqquno, sheakshav osehu keli chadash lehishtammesh bo derek hanneqeb al yede barza. Vaapillu lo asa lo barza ella satam hanneqeb legamre shello [yippatechu] od, vaapillu lo setamo bezepet vekayyotze bo ella shettachab bo etz vekayyotze bo bechozeq (im hu keli etz) — moelet bo setima zo laasot keli kemo shemmoelet bo barza. Abal im peqaqo bismartut — eno moil laasot keli, lepi shehu tiqqun aray veeno asuy lehitqayyem (vehu haddin im setamo betit — tiqqun aray hu bikli shemmishtammeshin bo bemayim, velaken eno moil lintilat yadayim). Vaapillu setima yapa kezepet vekayyotze bo enah moelet, im sotem lepi shaa veatid lehachazirah leachar zeman. Ubikli cheres en setima moelet ella bezepet o goprit, o sid meorab begipsis, o bibdil veoperet, o beqolan shel soperim shemmedabbeqim bahem neyarotehem (veen tzarik lomar bedebeq), abal lo bishar debarim. Ubikle zekukit en setima moelet kelal laasotam keli, apillu bedil veoperet vekayyotze bahem. Veken kele mattakot shettashmishan bechammin, kegon qumequm vekayyotze bo — en zepet vekayyotze bo middebarim hannimmosim bechammin moilot laasotam keli lintilat yadayim, ella im ken yichadam lintilat yadayim, sheim lo ken setima sheenah asuya lehitqayyem hi, vehu haddin lequmequm shel cheres o qedera vekayyotze bahem, abal shear kele mattakot moelet bahem setimat zepet vekayyotze bo. Veyesh omerim sheen zepet vekayyotze bo moil ella bikle cheres (ukele mattakot), velo bikle etz. Vaapillu keli etz shalem sheshshulayv hem nesarim medubbaqim bezepet — en notelin mimmennu, ap al pi shekkak naasa mittechillato. Velo hittiru bebarza ella lepi shehu etz, veetz beetz mithaddeq heteb:

Yesh omerim shello ameru [shiur] kones mashqeh ella bikli shalem shenniqqab, abal gistera shiuro bemotzi mashqeh. Veezeh gistera? Kol keli shennishbar mimmennu qetzat, vaapillu lo nishberu ella oznayv sheochazim oto bahem letaltelo mimmaqom lemaqom, lepi shekkeli shalem shenniqqab kemotzi mashqeh mishtammeshin bo mashqin al yede shemmaamidin tachtayv gistera leqabbel mashqin hannotepin, abal en maamidin gistera legistera. Verauy lachosh ledibrehem:

Yesh omerim shello ameru shiur kones mashqeh ella bikli shenniqqab, abal nitbaqqea — shiuro bemotzi mashqeh. Veyesh omerim sheen chilluq ben niqqab lenitbaqqea venisdaq, shelleolam eno batel mittorat keli bepachot mikkones mashqeh, lepi sherauy lehishtammesh bo al yede haamadat gistera tachtayv. Veken iqqar. Vekol neqeb o sedeq shemmayim yotzeim bo tippa achar tippa — beyadua shehu kones mashqeh, upasul ledibre hakkol:

Lo yemalle chopnayv mayim veyitten lachabero al yadayv, sheen notelin ella min hakkeli. Vehu haddin im natal yado achat min hakkeli veachar kak shapak mimmenna leyado hashsheniyya — lo olta lo netila. Veyesh mattirin bazeh, shekkevan shennetilat yado harishona hayeta mehakkeli — niqret netilat hashsheniyya netila mikkoach hakkeli, mah sheen ken keshechabero natan lo bechopnayv, sheen baim al yado shel zeh mikkoach keli ella shellachabero bau min hakkeli. Veken nahagu miqqedem lehaqel. Abal haiqqar kassebara harishona, velaken yesh lehachamir lekattechilla. Veap hammattirin lo hittiru ella kesheyyado harishona hayeta tehora, kegon sheshshapak aleha rebiit bebat achat venithara umeqabbel bah od mayim veshopek mimmenna al hashsheniyya gam ken rebiit bebat achat, o apillu meat mayim rishonim usheniyyim umeshapshep zo bazo sheyyaggiu hammayim bashsheniyya bekol happereq hatztzarik netilat yadayim. Abal im shapak al harishona pachot merebiit — nitmeu hammayim shealeha, ukesheshshopekam al hashsheniyya — metammein hammayim et hayyad hashsheniyya, vegam yad hashsheniyya metamme et hammayim sheal gabbe harishona keshemmeshapshep bah, ukeshechozer venotel mayim sheniyyim letaher harishonim — enan moilot kelum letaharam mittumatam shennitmeu miyyad hashsheniyya, sheen hammayim sheniyyim metaharim harishonim ella keshennitmeu min hayyad sheshshepakam aleha velo keshennitmeu miyyad acheret, venisheret yad zo betumatah ad sheyyenaggebah yapeh mimmemeha veyachazor veyittelah karauy. Vegam yad hashsheniyya shennitmea mimme harishona — en mayim sheniyyim moilim letaharah, vetzarik lenaggebah velachazor velittelah. Veap im natal gam mayim sheniyyim al yado harishona qodem sheshshapak mimmenna lehashsheniyya, mikkol maqom keshemmeshapshepan zo bazo — nitmeu me harishonim min hashsheniyya vechozerim umetammeim et harishona. Abal kesheshshopek rebiit bebat achat — enan meqabbelin tuma kelal mehayyadayim, lo miyyad zo sheshshepakam aleha velo miyyad zo sheshshipshepa bahem. Vehu sheyyishpok techilla harebiit al kol happereq hatztzarik netilat yadayim layyad harishona (umeqabbel od mayim leshapshep bahem hashsheniyya), abal im meqabbel rebiit bepissat hayyad lebad umeshapshep bahem shette yadayv — lo olta lo netila, ki miyyad sheqqibbel hammayim bepissat yado — nitmeu, shello ameru: rebiit mayim en meqabbelim tuma — ella bederek netila, shehu, kesheshshopekam al kol happereq, shehi nithara bintila zo, abal im shepakam al hachetzi — hare chetzi zeh betumato ledibre haomerim sheen yadayim tehorot lachatzain, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman qs"b, vechozer umetamme et hayyadayim, ukeshemmeshapshep bahem kol yadayv — nitmeu kol yadayv, vetzarik lenaggeban. Veyesh omerim shello hittiru hammattirin ella keshettiher yado harishona birbiit o bemayim rishonim usheniyyim umeqabbel bah od veshopek al hashsheniyya gam ken o rebiit o mayim rishonim usheniyyim sheyyaggiu lekol happereq, abal im shipshep hashsheniyya barishona lehaggia hammayim rishonim usheniyyim lekol happereq — lo olta lo netila, lepi shehammayim harishonim metammein et hayyad harishona bingiat hayyad hashsheniyya bahem. Veap im mayim harishonim ellu hem merebiit shettiharu yad harishona, mikkol maqom, kevan shennishtayyeru bah meat mehem ushepakam al hashsheniyya — nitmeu miyyad hashsheniyya, shehare en bahem rebiit, vechozerin umetammein yad harishona bingiatah bahem keshemmeshapshep bah (veken iqqar. Uledibre hakkol, im natal b' yadayv bebat achat, sheadam acher shopek alehen — naasu shettehen keyad achat, veenan metammeot zo et zo bingiatan zo bazo keshemmeshapshepan bemayim zo bazo lehaggia hammayim lekol happereq. Vaapillu eno shopek alehen kol harebiit, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman qs"b, veap al pi sheen hammayim maggiim lekol happereq mikkoach hakkeli ella beshipshupo — en bekak kelum):

Tzarik sheyyabou hammayim al yadayv min hakkeli mikkoach noten velo mealehem, shekken matzinu beme chattat, shenneemar bahem: "vehizza hattahor al hattame". Lepikak, tzinnor sheddolin mayim min hayyeor veshopekin bo venimshakin mimmennu hammayim lehashqot hassadeh — eno yakol litten yadayv letoko o tachtayv kede sheyyeqallechu hammayim alehen kesheyyaggiu lahen, mippene sheenan baim al yado mikkoach adam, shekkebar pasaq koach hashshopek. Veim mesim yado qarob limqom hashshepika, ap al pi sheeno mesim tachat hashshepika mammash — olta lo netila, shekkol zeman shehammayim qerobim limqom hashshepika — adayin mikkoach adam hem baim. Veap al pi shehatztzinnor hammonea hammayim millehitpashshet litzdade nahar eno keli — en bekak kelum, kevan sheiqqar hilluk hammayim hu mikkoach keli:

Im hitbil yadayv betok hatztzinnor enan tehorot mikkoach tebila, mippene shehem sheubin. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehaddoleh shopek venoten letok hatztzinnor atzmo, abal im noten otam chutz latztzinnor al haqqarqa umamshik otam latztzinnor vehitbil bo yadayv — tehorot, shehashshe[u]ba shehimshikuha baqqarqa — keshera lintilat yadayim shehi middibre soperim, ap lehapposelim bitbilat kol gupo shehi min hattora ad sheyyihyeh rob hammiqveh me geshamim vehammiut sheuba shehimshikuhu, kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea siman r"a. Umikkol maqom, tzarik sheyyehe batztzinnor m' sea, vesheyyigdor betoko lematta leakkeb zechilat hammayim, sheyyihyu niqvim veomedim velo zochalin, kemo sheyyitbaer:

Vaapillu doleh venoten letok tzinnor atzmo, im haddeli naqub meachorayv kekones mashqeh ubeod sheshshopek derek piv latztzinnor meqalleach meachorayv layor — matbil bo et hayyadayim beshaa shehaddeli shopek letoko, venechshab keillu hitbil bayyeor, shehaqqilluach shemmeachore haddeli mechabber meme haddeli lememe hayor, vehannitztzoq shemmehaddeli latztzinnor mechabber mayim shebbatztzinnor lammayim shebbaddeli, vachashubim mayim shebbatztzinnor mechubbarim leme hayor. Veap al pi shehannitztzoq eno chashub chibbur litbilat kol gupo, vegam haqqilluach shemmeachore haddeli eno nitztzoq im en bo ella kekones mashqeh betzimtzum shehu yored tippa achar tippa — ap al pi ken leinyan netilat yadayim heqellu shebbedabar muat chashub chibbur. Lepikak, haholek bispina bayyam veeno yakol lehatbil yadayv bayyam — yiqqach keli menuqqab bekones mashqeh vedoleh bo mehayyam umatbil bo yadayv, shemmemayv mechubbarim leme hayyam, hoil vehem notepin mimmennu layyam derek hanneqeb. (Abal im epshar lo beqal lehatbil yadayv bayyam — en lo laasot ken, lepi sheyyesh choleqin al zeh veomerim, shehannitztzoq eno chibbur lintilat yadayim kemo sheeno chibbur litbilat kol gupo. Veap al pi shehaiqqar kassebara harishona, mikkol maqom, bemaqom sheepshar "mihyot tob — al tiqra ra"). Abal i epshar lidlot bikli shalem velittol mimmennu layyadayim bederek netila, mippene shemme hayyam meluchim hem upesulim lintilat yadayim, veenam kesherim ella bederek tebila, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman q"s:

Abanim haqqebuim bakkotel shechaqaq bahen bet qibbul vetiqqen lahem barza — en littol mehen layyadayim, shekkevan shehem qebuim bakkotel leolam — hare hen kekotel, veen shem keli alehen, ap al pi sheasa lahen bet qibbul. Abal im chaqaq lahen bet qibbul techilla veachar kak chibberan bakkotel — notelin mehen, hoil vehaya alehen shem keli betalush. Veken keli hamchubbar laqqarqa notelin mimmennu. Vehu sheyyesh lo barza venotel derek barza shemmesirah bekol shepika ushepika, shezzo niqret netila mikkoach noten, kemo sheyyitbaer, abal im hiknis yadayv letok hakkeli veshikshekan bammayim — lo olta lo netila, shezzo enah netila, ella keen hatbala hi zo, hoil vehakkeli mechubbar laqqarqa, veen tebila bishubin. Abal im en hakkeli mechubbar laqqarqa — hare zo derek netila, ap al pi sheen baim al yadayv mikkoach noten, lepi shebben shennotel yadayv mittok hakkeli uben maknis yadayv letok hakkeli — hakkol niqra netila bikli, mah sheen ken betzinnor sheeno keli, mippene sheen lo d' depanot, lepikak hitzriku sheyyitten bo yadayv qarob lishpikat haddeli, sheyyabou hammayim al yadayv mikkoach shopek mehakkeli. Vehu haddin lekol mi sheochez yadayv chutz lakkeli — tzarik sheyyabou hammayim al yadayv mikkoach noten mehakkeli. Abal keshemmesim yadayv betok hakkeli — en tzarik lenoten, raq sheyyehe bammayim keshiur netila shehi rebiit, veen tzarik lihyot keshiur tebila shehu m' sea. Veyesh omerim shelleolam enah chashuba netila ella im ken bau hammayim al yadayv mikkoach noten, kemo shemmatzinu beqiddush yadayim veraglayim bammiqdash, diktib "verachatzu mimmennu" — velo betoko, shebbetoko eno rochetz mikkoach noten, abal chutza lo rochetz al yede hasarat habbarza mehaddad hayyotze mimmennu, vezeh niqra koach noten, kemo sheyyitbaer. Ubishat haddechaq — yakol lismok al sebara harishona, vibarek "al netilat yadayim", veim achar kak nizdammen lo littol kederek netila — yittol belo beraka. Veyesh oserin apillu bishat haddechaq, lepi shehaiqqar kassebara haacharona (veyesh lachosh ledibrehem shello lebarek al netila zo, ella notel belo beraka, veyikrok yadayv bemappa veyokal, sheyyesh mi shemmattir al yede mappa bekol maqom, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman qs"g):

Chabit sheyyesh bah mayim — mannichah al birkayv venotel, ki mah shebbirkayv mesayyein lishpok nechshab koach noten. Veim hayeta mutta baaretz al yede shennitgalgela meeleha vehammayim meqallechim mimmenna, o sheomedet vehammayim yotzeim derek hanneqeb al yede shennopla habbarza meeleha venatan yadayv sham — lo olta lo netila. Abal im hesir habbarza veqibbel hammayim al yadayv — nechshebet hasarato dabar hammonea shepikat hammayim keillu shapak hammayim beyadayv. Umikkol maqom, tzarik lehachazirah velahasirah bekol shepika ushepika hayyotzet mehanneqeb, sheqqilluach rishon lebad nechshab keillu ba mikkocho veachar kak meqalleach meelayv. Lepikak, hannotel mikkiyyor shemmetuqqan al yede tarnegol keen barza — tzarik lahapok hattarnegol kamma peamim bekol netilat yad veyad, lepi shehaqqilluach hu daq veen maspiq lishpok al kol happereq hatztzarik netila beqilluach rishon hayyotze mehanneqeb:

Im hitta chabit melea mayim vehalak veyashab lo vehechabit shopeket mayim kol hayyom mechamat hattayato venatal yadayv mimmenna — olta lo netila, ki kol hammayim hayyotzeim mehechabit mikkocho hem yotzeim, shebbehattayato henia kol hammayim mechamat hattaya zo, mah sheen ken babbarza shello asa maaseh begup hammayim ella shehesir dabar hammoneam millatzet, laken eno nechshab mikkocho ella qilluach rishon hayyotze miyyad min hanneqeb sheppatach:

Im haqqop noten mayim layyadayim — yesh makshirin, lepi shello hitzriku ella koach noten bilbad, yihyeh mi sheyyihyeh. Veyesh omerim shehitzriku sheyyabou hammayim mikkoach adam davqa, kemo beme chattat. Veyesh lachosh ledibrehem lekattechilla, abal bediabad yesh lismok al sebara harishona lehaqel bedibre soperim. Vehu shehannotel mitkavven leshem netila hammaksheret laakila, kemo shennitbaer besiman qn"ch, mah sheen ken kesheadam noten layyadayim — moelet kavvanat hannoten, ap al pi shehannotel eno mitkavven kelal. Veim hannoten hu pachot mibben shesh — yesh mi sheomer sheddino keqop, lepi sheen bo daat kelal, veen kavvanato kavvana. Abal mibben shesh vaelak ap al pi shehu qatan, veken cheresh veshoteh, o apillu nokri — moelet kavvanatam, ap al pi shehannotel eno mitkavven. Veim hu mitkavven — yakol littol mecheresh shoteh veqatan venokri ap al pi sheenan mitkavvenim, shekkullam qeruyim "adam" leinyan biat mayim mikkoach adam lintilat yadayim. Veken muttar littol mehannidda, im hi bitto o mesharetet shello. Ap al pi shehannidda veken hannokri metammeim bemassa, venitmeu hammayim shebbakkeli ap al pi shello nageu bahem, vehaek yetaharu hammayim et hayyadayim apillu lechullin, kevan shennotelin mishshum serek teruma, velitruma hen pesulot mippene shennitmeu mehammayim hattemeim? Mikkol maqom, kevan sheanu kullanu temee metim, vei epshar lihyot lanu mayim tehorim — en lachosh gam letumat hannokri vehannidda. Veyesh machamirin benidda venokri, kevan sheepshar lizzaher mittumatan, veen danin epshar mishshei epshar. Vetob lachosh ledibrehem, shello leqabbel netila minnidda venokri. Abal im hannokri hebi mayim bikli vehu notel beatzmo — en lachosh (shezzehu gam ken dabar shei epshar). Umi sheyyukal lehizzaher gam bazeh — ashrayv:

Hammatbil yadayv beme miqveh, ap al pi sheen hammayim baim al yado mikkoach noten — yadayv tehorot, im kol gupo nithar bahem — yadayv lo kol shekken? Vehu sheruyim litbol bahem kol gupo, dehaynu sheyyesh bahem m' sea, abal pachot mim' sea, o shehem zochalin — pesulin gam litbilat yadayim. Veyesh omerim, sheapillu en bahem ella rebiit, kevan sheenan sheubim, vehem baqqarqa — kesherim litbilat yadayim, lepi shemmin hattora en tzarik m' sea leshum tebila ella litbilat kol gupo bilbad, lepi shezzehu shiur mayim shekkol gupo oleh bahem bebat achat, sheen tebila lachatzain, abal tebilat kelim day birbiit me geshamim shebbaqqarqa im hakkeli mitkasseh betok hammayim, kegon mechatin vetzinnorot, ella shehachakamim ameru shello yehe chilluq ben tebilat gupo litbilat kelim, vehitzriku hakkol bem' sea, vekevan shettebilat kelim shehi min hattora dayyah birbiit, kol shekken netilat yadayim shehi middibre soperim sheddayyah birbiit, kevan sheyyadayv mitkassot bahem. Veyesh lismok al dibrehem lehaqel bedibre soperim bediabad, abal lekattechilla yesh lehachamir kassebara harishona:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Beme miqveh, shehem me geshamim vehapsharat shelagim vekayyotze bahem shenniqvu venitqabbetzu limqom ashboren, abal me mayan — ledibre hakkol kesherim litbilat yadayim, kol shemmitkassim bahem yadayv bebat achat, lepi sheggam litbilat kol gupo yesh makshirin kol shekkol gupo oleh bahem bebat achat ap al pi sheen bahem m' sea, kegon leadam qatan, kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea siman r"a, vaapillu hem zochalin. Abal me geshamim vehapsharat shelagim vekayyotze bahem shehem zochalin — yesh lehistappeq lepi sebara haacharona im heqellu bintilat yadayim gam bezochalin kemo sheheqelu bepachot mim' sea, o shello heqellu bezochalin mippene sheppesulot gam litbilat kelim min hattora (velaken yachazor veyittol kahalaka, velo yebarek im berak al hannetila harishona, ki shemma natal uberak kahalaka, usepeq berakot lehaqel):

Vekol zeh beme miqveh, abal mayim sheubin, apillu hem bimqom ashboren veyesh bahem m' sea — pesulot litbilat yadayim. Veyesh makshirin bem' sea sheubin baqqarqa, hoil vehem kesherim litbilat baale qerayin hatztzerikim tebila ledibre tora mittaqqanat ezra kemo shennitbaer besiman p"ch (vehaiqqar kassebara harishona). Umayim shebbikli hamchubbar laqqarqa — ledibre hakkol pesulim litbilat yadayim (vaapillu hem me geshamim, sheen tebila bekelim, kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea siman r"a). Ushe[u]ba shehimshikuha al gabbe qarqa — ledibre hakkol keshera lintilat yadayim, kemo shennitbaer lemala:

Lo yittol mayim mehannahar beyado achat veyitten al yado hashshenit, lepi sheen kan lo netila velo tebila, shennetila hi min hakkeli veyado enah keli. Abal im natal yado achat min hakkeli veachat bitbila — yadayv tehorot, umebarek "al netilat yadayim". Abal hammatbil b' yadayv — yesh omerim sheeno mebarek "al netilat yadayim", ella "al tebilat yadayim", o "al shetipat yadayim", lepi shellashon netila nitqan al shem hakkeli shenniqra "natla". Veyesh omerim shemmebarek "al netilat yadayim" velo "al tebilat yadayim", shehekan tzivvanu al tebilat yadayim, abal al netilat yadayim tzivvanu, veyesh biklal matayim maneh, shemmechamat chiyyub hannetila shetztzivvanu anu matbilin akshav. Veyesh mi shehikria, sheim matbil bemayim hakkesherim lintila — mebarek "al netilat yadayim", abal im matbil bemayim hakkesherim litbila velo lintila, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman q"s — mebarek "al tebilat yadayim" (vehambarek "al shetipat yadayim" — yotze ledibre hakkol):

Hammatbil yadayv — en tzarik shette peamim, kemo shehitzriku mayim sheniyyim bintila letaher harishonim shennitmeu mehayyadayim im en rebiit, abal bitbila en kan mayim temeim kelal. Veken en tzarik lenaggeb yadayv, kemo shennitbaer besiman qn"ch. Veken en tzarik lehagbiah yadayv, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman qs"b:
